attr.title: Gates of Skeldal
attr.desc: Gates of Skeldal is a cult classic Czech dungeon crawler from 1998. On the mythical island of Rovenland, a party of adventurers sets out to stop five rogue mages from the tower of Skeldal. Enjoy turn-based combat, powerful magic, and tricky puzzles in this legendary RPG!
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Steam, open the game properties and Game Versions and Betas select the public_beta branch and download the game. Copy downloaded files into port folder (skeldal).
attr.inst_md: Purchase the game on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3533830/Brany_Skeldalu/), open the game properties and `Game Versions and Betas` select the `public_beta` branch and download the game. Copy downloaded files into port folder (`skeldal`).
